provenance.purpose: Curated disposition for NECB 2025 Section 8.4 articles that no gem manifest declares: who or what satisfies each one. Consumed by scripts/generate_necb_8_4_coverage.rb.

categories.engine: satisfied by EnergyPlus itself (physics the simulation engine performs)
categories.modeller: the modeller's or AHJ's responsibility — a scoping or input decision, not software
categories.covered_by: satisfied by named gem code that has not (yet) declared a manifest entry for this article
categories.gap: genuinely uncovered — nothing in the family satisfies it

provenance.rules: Every entry needs a rationale. A disposition is a claim of RESPONSIBILITY, not of correctness — the weaker claim is deliberate. Entries are drafts until a named human reviews them; the generator renders drafts distinctly and flags any article that is both dispositioned and declared/cited (conflicts are surfaced, never silently resolved).

8.4.1.3.rationale: The Part 3-7 Section .4 limitations are applicability conditions on using the performance path at all — a scoping judgement made before any software runs.

8.4.1.4.rationale: Whether an addition is assessed by itself or together with the existing building is the modeller's scoping decision; the pipeline evaluates whatever model is supplied.

8.4.2.4.rationale: Thermal mass is inherent in EnergyPlus's conduction transfer function / finite difference surface heat balance; no gem input is required beyond the constructions already in the model.

8.4.2.5.rationale: Dynamic space-temperature calculation is EnergyPlus's zone air heat balance, computed every timestep by construction.

8.4.2.6.rationale: (1) inter-block conduction is modeled by EnergyPlus where the separating surfaces exist, BUT (2) mandates a specific 0.35 W/(m2.K) coefficient for adjacent blocks not fully separated by solid partitions — that is an INPUT nothing in the family sets. Not an engine freebie.

8.4.2.8.rationale: Dynamic wall/roof/floor heat transfer with orientation- and absorptance-dependent solar radiation is EnergyPlus's surface heat balance; absorptances themselves are model inputs (see 8.4.3.3 / 8.4.5.3 for who sets them).

8.4.2.11.rationale: ANSI/ASHRAE 140 testing is a property of the simulation software: EnergyPlus publishes ASHRAE 140 test results. The modeller cites the E+ version used; nothing for the gems to do.

8.4.2.12.rationale: Exceptional calculation methods for systems the software cannot model are constructed and justified by the modeller case-by-case.

8.4.3.7.rationale: The +/-1degC default throttling range when the proposed specifications are silent is set by nothing in the family; E+ ZoneControl throttling defaults are whatever the supplied model carries.

8.4.3.8.rationale: Proposed-side part-load curves must match the specified equipment — a property of the supplied model. The (2) fallback to Subsection 8.4.6 curves when specs are unavailable is NOT automated (see the 8.4.6.x gap entries).

8.4.3.9.rationale: No ice-plant or ice-plant-heat-recovery handling (double-bundle chiller representation) exists anywhere in the family.

8.4.6.1.rationale: Part-load curves ARE applied by the efficiency passes (boiler/furnace/DX/SWH verified, chiller+others not yet compared) — probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb, as-applied model curves vs NECB 2025 coefficients). rake necb:curves is the ongoing gate.

8.4.6.2.rationale: VERIFIED EQUIVALENT: applied normalized-efficiency curve tracks the Table 8.4.6.2 non-condensing FHeatPLC within 1.88% over PLR 0.25-1.0 — probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb, as-applied model curves vs NECB 2025 coefficients). The condensing 6-term row is not compared (no condensing boiler in the reference builds).

8.4.6.3.rationale: VERIFIED EQUIVALENT: gas-coil PLF curve tracks the Table 8.4.6.3 atmospheric FHeatPLC within 0.77% — probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb, as-applied model curves vs NECB 2025 coefficients).

8.4.6.4.rationale: VERIFIED EQUIVALENT (fixed 2026-07-22): CAP_FT and EIR_FT are the code surfaces exactly (0.01%/0.00%, exact degF->degC transforms — EIR_FT was regenerated from the code after the probe caught the legacy 2011-derived surface deviating 1.95%); the EIR_FPLR/PLF cycling mapping was refit from the code cubic to its structural floor of ~2.0% (was 3.70%), output clamped to [0.7, 1.0]. NECB 2020 8.4.5.4 and 2025 8.4.6.4 coefficients verified identical. probed by scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb (rake necb:curves).

8.4.6.5.rationale: VERIFIED EQUIVALENT (Scroll + Reciprocating, water-cooled): CAP_FT, EIR_FPLR and EIR_FT all match at 0.00%. EIR_FT is compared against ERRATUM-CORRECTED coefficients: the PRINTED Table 8.4.5.5-C (2020) / 8.4.6.5-C (2025) rows carry single misplaced-decimal defects (Scroll d, Reciprocating b; the printed Reciprocating row yields a physically impossible negative power ratio at the AHRI rating point) — a publication error identical in both editions, NOT an extraction defect; errata proposed to NRC Codes Canada 2026-07-22. The corrections are corroborated EXACTLY by the independent legacy NECB-2011-lineage vendored curves (all six coefficients, <4e-6 relative, both rows). Screw/Centrifugal chiller types not yet probed. probed by scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb.

8.4.6.6.rationale: STRUCTURAL: the reference tower is CoolingTowerSingleSpeed, which has NO curve fields — E+ models tower capacity vs wet-bulb physically (effectiveness/UA), not via the code's FWB polynomial, and no FWB curve is vendored. Whether the physical model is an acceptable stand-in for the 8.4.6.6 formulation is an engineering judgement for the reviewer, not a code fix. probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb).

8.4.6.7.rationale: VERIFIED EQUIVALENT: ASHP heating CAP_FTEAS and EIR_FT are the code cubics exactly (0.00%/0.01%, degF->degC univariate transform); EIR_FPLR via the PLF cycling transform within 1.83%. The -10degC cutoff is separately applied per 8.4.5.13. probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb).

8.4.6.8.rationale: NOT APPLICABLE today: no absorption chiller exists in the reference catalog, no absorption curves are vendored, and apply_chiller's compressor-type detection never selects absorption — NOTE it would silently fall back to Scroll if an absorption chiller ever appeared (a latent silent-fallback to fix before absorption support is claimed). probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb).

8.4.6.9.rationale: VERIFIED EQUIVALENT: water-heater part-load factor curve tracks the 8.4.6.9.(2) FHeatPLC within 0.98% — probed 2026-07-22 (scripts/necb_8_4_6_curve_probe.rb, as-applied model curves vs NECB 2025 coefficients).
